note: The two witnesses to the antiphon have zero substantive divergence. The two complete witnesses to the devotional continuation agree in wording and order. John Paul II's 1991 prayer at Jasna Gora independently attests the same continuation, but places Advocata before Mediatrix and prints recomenda; it is cited as supporting context rather than normalized into a mechanical collation witness.

adjudicated.ruling: The Compendium prints the ae digraph; the edition applies its regular liturgical ae-ligature house form. The letters and reading are unchanged.
